article.title: Brandlight公布AI Ads，先與指定早期客戶合作
article.title_en: Brandlight introduces AI Ads with selected early customers

article.summary_en: Brandlight introduced AI Ads on October 29, combining organic AI visibility intelligence, paid advertising data and customer marketing insights for campaign planning and optimization.

highlights_en: Described uses include conversation-context analysis, competitive visibility comparisons, and creative and landing-page refinement.
The company is working with selected early customers and offers a waitlist for enterprise teams interested in ChatGPT Ads.
article.detail:
Brandlight於10月29日公布AI Ads，表示把自然AI曝光情報、付費廣告資料及客戶行銷資料結合，用於AI介面廣告規劃與優化。

公司列出的應用包括對話情境分析、競爭曝光比較及素材與落地頁調整。

目前與指定早期客戶合作，對ChatGPT Ads有興趣的企業可加入候補名單。

品牌可評估自然曝光與付費投放如何共用洞察，測試仍需區分樣本對話、實際展示及成交。

查詢接入資格與資料範圍，以小額測試比較素材、對話相關性及可取得的成效紀錄。

公司提及的點擊率及成本改善未有足夠獨立驗證，本刊不刊載該成效數字；不視為全面開放。
article.detail_en:
Brandlight introduced AI Ads on October 29, combining organic AI visibility intelligence, paid advertising data and customer marketing insights for campaign planning and optimization.

Described uses include conversation-context analysis, competitive visibility comparisons, and creative and landing-page refinement.

The company is working with selected early customers and offers a waitlist for enterprise teams interested in ChatGPT Ads.

Brands can assess shared insights across organic visibility and paid media while separating sampled conversations, delivered impressions and sales.

Confirm eligibility and data scope, then use a small test to compare creative, conversational relevance and available performance records.

Reported click-rate and cost improvements lack independent validation here and are omitted; this is not universal availability.
